spanish: Y era voz del shofar andante y muy fuerte; Moisés hablaba, y Dios le respondía en voz.
grammarChanges: Replaced the reflexive gerund 'fortaleciéndose' with the plain adjective 'fuerte' (adverb 'muy') to match the masculine singular adjective חזק without adding an inchoative process or a reflexive actor.
Adjusted sequence of tenses: 'habla' → 'hablaba' and 'responde' → 'respondía' to keep the piel imperfect ידבר and qal imperfect יעננו in past-narrative aspect under the ויהי frame.
readerNote: hold: clause role — the qal participle הולך predicates קול (the voice), but 'andante' placed after 'shofar' can still be read as modifying the horn; left as drafted.
